annotations.title: Rename, share or stop sharing a named list

description: Changes one of the signed-in person's lists: `name` renames it; `shared: true` makes a read-only link (a new random token, an older link stops working), `shared: false` removes the link. The link shows the list's name and products at today's prices, never the owner, the notes or the saved prices. Another id answers not_found.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

name.description: The list's name, e.g. Narozeniny (1 to 80 characters).

name: update_list
